name: artemis-comparison-photo-comparison
title: Comparison photo comparison
description: A draggable before and after photo comparison with scene tabs, keyboard control, a one-time invitation sweep, live metrics and a histogram that follow the divider, and hold to compare.
docs: artemis-comparison-photo-comparison: 3 demo images are not part of the shadcn install. Download from the URLs in meta.assets into the same public/ paths, or install with the zeus-ui CLI, which copies them.
